title: Reporter titrations for transfection of Micromonas commoda CCMP2709
author: Lisa Sudek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8p8hvrw
materials: Resuspend the cell pellet in 58.8 µl of the SF buffer/supplement solution (Lonza) prepared above (step 14) and quickly add the cell suspension to the mastermixes (see below) at 2 µl per transfection reaction. Carefully mix by gentle pipetting.

steps.title: Prepare Carrier DNA Stock
steps.instruction: Purchase pUC19 at 20 µg µl-1 in 10 mM TrisHCl pH8, aliquot in 100 µl volumes, and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Reporter Plasmid Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare reporter plasmid stock (e.g., H3proMpo-LUC) via E. coli XL-Blue Competent Cells transformation.

substeps.instruction: Grow transformed E. coli on LB-Ampicillin plates (100 µg ml-1) at 37°C overnight (16-18 hr).
Inoculate one colony into 5 ml liquid LB Amp (100 µg ml-1) and grow at 37°C and ~250 rpm for ~16 hr.
Centrifuge culture at 6000 x g for 10 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 5 ml LB medium.
Inoculate 220 ml LB-Amp (100 µg ml-1) with 2 ml of the cell suspension and grow at 37°C and ~200 rpm for ~16 hr.
Purify plasmid using Qiagen Maxi Prep Kit.
Quantify concentration using NanoDrop™ One/OneC; aim for 5-10 µg µl-1 (ideally 10 µg µl-1).
Aliquot into 1.7 ml microcentrifuge tubes and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Culture Micromonas commoda CCMP2709
steps.instruction: Maintain M. commoda in mid-exponential growth for ≥10 generations in L1 medium.

substeps.instruction: Prepare L1 medium using natural seawater base adjusted to 22 PSU (e.g., 550 ml natural seawater from North Eastern Pacific, 36 PSU + 450 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O).
Set growth chamber to 21°C with a 14:10-h light:dark cycle (~140 µmol photon m-2 s-1 PAR).
Transfer culture approximately every 3 days to a density of 4 x 10 6 cells ml-1 (expected growth rate 0.56 ± 0.06 day-1).

steps.title: Configure Nucleofector System
steps.instruction: Set up the Lonza 4D-Nucleofector™ System (X Unit AAF-1002X, Core Unit AAF-1002B, 96-well Shuttle AAM-1001S).

substeps.instruction: Create a template file in the Lonza program.
Select positions/wells in the 96-well plate to be pulsed.
Assign a 'Cell type program' for each well: either pulse EW-113 or 'no program' (no pulse) for controls.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Workspace
steps.instruction: Prepare buffers and sterilize the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Recovery Buffer: 10 mM HEPES-KOH pH 7.5, 530 mM Sorbitol, 4.7% (w/v) PEG 8000 (22 PSU). Per 100 ml: 1 ml 1M HEPES pH7.5 + 99 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O + 4.7g PEG 8000 + 10.2 g D-Sorbitol. Filter sterilize (0.2 µm) and store at 4°C.
Prepare ATP solution (250 mM, pH 7.5): Per 100 ml, add 15.13 g ATP to 100 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O. Adjust to pH 7.5 with NaOH, filter (0.2 µm), and store at 4°C.

Prepare Luciferase Buffer: 50mM HEPES pH 7.5, 200 mM NaCl, 20% Glycerol. Per 100 ml: 80 ml 18.2 MΩ·cm MilliQ H2O + 20 ml 50% glycerol + 1.1915 g HEPES. Adjust to pH 7.5 with KOH. Add 0.1168 g NaCl to 10 ml of this solution. Filter sterilize (0.2 µm) and store at 4°C.
Thaw on ice: Carrier DNA (pUC19, 20 µg µl-1), reporter plasmid (H3proMpo-LUC, 10 µg µl-1), recovery buffer, ATP pH 7.5 (250 mM), and Lonza buffer SF with supplement (V4-SC-2096).
Wipe laminar flow hood and equipment (pipettes, tips, L1 medium, 12-well plates, 1.7 ml tubes, multichannel pipette, 96-well nucleofection plate, disposable basin) with 70% EtOH.

steps.title: Harvest Micromonas Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the cell suspension for transfection.

substeps.instruction: Determine cell concentration via flow cytometer (BD Accuri C6); target 15-22 x 10 6 cells ml-1.
For 28 reactions, harvest 58.8 ml of culture by centrifuging at 5000 x g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and store pellet at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Mastermixes
steps.instruction: Create 6 mastermixes for reporter plasmid concentrations (final: 0, 0.3, 3, 10, 20, and 30 µg).

substeps.instruction: Each reaction contains: 15 µl Buffer SF (Lonza), 2 µl 20 µg/µl pUC19, 1 µl 250 mM ATP solution, and 2 µl cell suspension in SF buffer.
Add reporter DNA (H3proMpo-LUC, 10 µg/µl) as follows: 0 µl, 0.3 µl (of a 1:10 dilution), 0.3 µl, 1 µl, 2 µl, or 3 µl.
Add cell suspension last and mix gently by slow pipetting.
Run reactions and no-pulse controls (30 µg reporter) in biological triplicates.

steps.title: Perform Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Pulse the cells using the Lonza 4D-Nucleofector™ System.

substeps.instruction: Add specific volumes of mixture to a 96-well plate (V4SP-1096): 20 µl (0 µg), 20.3 µl (0.3 and 3 µg), 21 µl (10 µg), 22 µl (20 µg), or 23 µl (30 µg).
Insert plate into the 96-well Shuttle™ and apply pulse EW-113.
Verify pulse success via colorimetric indicator (Green = success, Red = failed).
Immediately add 100 µl ice-cold Recovery Buffer to each well to re-seal pores.
Gently mix by tapping sides of the plate and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to culture plates for recovery and growth.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 ml L1 medium to each well of a 12-well culture plate.
Transfer each transfection reaction to a separate well, mixing gently by pipetting.
Allow cells to rest for 30 min at room temperature.
Subsample 50 µl from each well to determine cell concentrations via flow cytometry.

steps.title: Incubation and Growth
steps.instruction: Incubate plates at 21°C under a 14:10-h light:dark cycle with increasing light intensity.

substeps.instruction: Day 0-1: 30 µmol photon m-2 s-1.
Day 1-2: 40 µmol photon m-2 s-1.
Day 2-7: 80 µmol photon m-2 s-1.
Subsample for flow cytometry on day 3 to calculate overall cell numbers.
Determine cell numbers using BD Accuri C6 flow cytometer.
Harvest 1 ml of each culture by centrifuging at 8000 x g for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove supernatant and store pellets on ice with luciferase buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Luciferase Standard Curve
steps.instruction: Create a standard curve using Nano-Glo 1000x enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Running Buffer for 45 reactions: mix 2.205 ml Nano-Glo buffer and 45 µl Nano-Glo substrate (50 µl per reaction).
Prepare Nano-Glo 1000x enzyme stock (1x10-2): mix 99 µl luciferase buffer with 1 µl Nano-Glo 1000x enzyme; store at 4°C in dark.
Set up 11 tubes for serial dilutions with running buffer: Tube 1 (1.50 µl), Tube 2 (2.50 µl), Tubes 3-11 (100 µl each).
Add 25 µl of 1x10-2 stock to tube #1, mix, and transfer 25 µl to tube #2. Then, transfer 50 µl from each subsequent dilution to the next, changing tips between steps.
Discard reactions #1 and #2. Split reactions #3-11 into duplicates (50 µl each) in a white 96-well flat bottom microplate and store in the dark.

steps.title: Measure Luminescence
steps.instruction: Quantify luciferase activity in cell pellets.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µl Running Buffer to each of the 22 cell pellets and resuspend completely (minimize foam).
Transfer resuspensions to a white 96-well flat bottom microplate and adapt in the dark for 1-10 min.
Measure luminescence on a Tecan plate reader (20 kinetic cycles, 500 ms per sample, 0 settle time).
Calculate mean/SD of standards, normalize to no-pulse controls, and calculate lumen per total number of cells.
